From a64917446eafc7212e962561622d697fce04e9a6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Aviv Heller <avivh@mellanox.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Dec 2018 19:03:27 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] net/mlx5: Fix LAG requirement when CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH is off

If CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH is not defined, test for SR-IOV being disabled,
instead of calling e-switch LAG prereq routine.

Since LAG with SRIOV is allowed only when switchdev mode is on.

Fixes: eff849b2c669 ("net/mlx5: Allow/disallow LAG according to pre-req only")
Signed-off-by: Aviv Heller <avivh@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: Saeed Mahameed <saeedm@mellanox.com>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/lag.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/lag.c
index 5187dc7a72a3..3a6baed722d8 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/lag.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/lag.c
@@ -291,12 +291,15 @@ static int mlx5_deactivate_lag(struct mlx5_lag *ldev)
 
 static bool mlx5_lag_check_prereq(struct mlx5_lag *ldev)
 {
-	if (ldev->pf[0].dev &&
-	    ldev->pf[1].dev &&
-	    mlx5_esw_lag_prereq(ldev->pf[0].dev, ldev->pf[1].dev))
-		return true;
-	else
+	if (!ldev->pf[0].dev || !ldev->pf[1].dev)
 		return false;
+
+#ifdef CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH
+	return mlx5_esw_lag_prereq(ldev->pf[0].dev, ldev->pf[1].dev);
+#else
+	return (!mlx5_sriov_is_enabled(ldev->pf[0].dev) &&
+		!mlx5_sriov_is_enabled(ldev->pf[1].dev));
+#endif
 }
 
 static void mlx5_lag_add_ib_devices(struct mlx5_lag *ldev)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/lag.c`**
- The function `mlx5_lag_check_prereq` was modified to change how it checks prerequisites for Link Aggregation Group (LAG).
- The original check for LAG prerequisites using `mlx5_esw_lag_prereq` was replaced with a conditional compilation directive (`#ifdef CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH`).
- If `CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH` is defined, it retains the original check using `mlx5_esw_lag_prereq`.
- If `CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH` is not defined, it now checks if SR-IOV is disabled for both devices instead of calling the e-switch LAG prerequisite routine.

### Relationships
- The modification in `lag.c` directly addresses a bug related to the handling of LAG requirements when the `CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH` configuration is not enabled. 
- The change ensures that the LAG prerequisites are correctly evaluated based on the configuration, preventing incorrect behavior when SR-IOV is disabled.
- This patch fixes a previously introduced issue (referenced by the `Fixes` tag) that allowed LAG with SR-IOV when it should not have been permitted, thus improving the overall correctness of the LAG functionality in the driver.

Here is the commit message:
net/mlx5: Fix LAG requirement when CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH is off

If CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH is not defined, test for SR-IOV being disabled,
instead of calling e-switch LAG prereq routine.

Since LAG with SRIOV is allowed only when switchdev mode is on.

Fixes: eff849b2c669 ("net/mlx5: Allow/disallow LAG according to pre-req only")
Signed-off-by: Aviv Heller <avivh@mellanox.com>
Signed-off-by: Saeed Mahameed <saeedm@mellanox.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect handling of LAG prerequisites when the `CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH` configuration is not defined. The original implementation called the e-switch LAG prerequisite routine regardless of the SR-IOV status, which allowed LAG configurations that should not be permitted when SR-IOV is disabled. This led to potential misconfigurations and incorrect behavior in the network driver.

Here is the patch:
 
 static bool mlx5_lag_check_prereq(struct mlx5_lag *ldev)
 {
-	if (ldev->pf[0].dev &&
-	    ldev->pf[1].dev &&
-	    mlx5_esw_lag_prereq(ldev->pf[0].dev, ldev->pf[1].dev))
-		return true;
-	else
+	if (!ldev->pf[0].dev || !ldev->pf[1].dev)
 		return false;
+
+#ifdef CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH
+	return mlx5_esw_lag_prereq(ldev->pf[0].dev, ldev->pf[1].dev);
+#else
+	return (!mlx5_sriov_is_enabled(ldev->pf[0].dev) &&
+		!mlx5_sriov_is_enabled(ldev->pf[1].dev));
+#endif
 }

```c

```
```c

```
```c
return true;
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the original implementation incorrectly calls the `mlx5_esw_lag_prereq` function to check LAG prerequisites without considering whether SR-IOV is enabled. This leads to allowing LAG configurations even when SR-IOV is disabled, which is not permitted when `CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH` is not defined.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
#ifdef CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH
return mlx5_esw_lag_prereq(ldev->pf[0].dev, ldev->pf[1].dev);
#else
return (!mlx5_sriov_is_enabled(ldev->pf[0].dev) && !mlx5_sriov_is_enabled(ldev->pf[1].dev));
#endif
```
Reason:
The fix introduces a conditional check based on the `CONFIG_MLX5_ESWITCH` configuration. If it is not defined, the code now correctly checks if SR-IOV is disabled for both devices before allowing LAG configurations. This ensures that LAG is only permitted when SR-IOV is enabled, thus preventing misconfigurations and ensuring correct behavior in the network driver.
